t.LINALOOL.agn: A fragrance allergen in the EU: it must be named in the ingredient list above 0.001% in leave-on and 0.01% in rinse-off products (Annex III, entry 84).
t.LINALOOL.eff.0: May cause skin reactions in people with fragrance allergy; this is why the EU requires it to be named on the label above a set level.
t.LINALOOL.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III, entry 84: fragrance allergen; must be named in the ingredient list above a set level.
t.LINALOOL.summary: A scent compound found in lavender and many flowers; a fragrance allergen.
t.LINALOOL.what: Gives the product a floral scent.
